## getUnsupportedVaultV2Adapter() function

Checks if an error is a contract revert with the "UnsupportedVaultV2Adapter" error name, returning the offending adapter address if so. Used to propagate adapter validation errors from the deployless `GetVaultV2.query` to the caller as a typed .

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function getUnsupportedVaultV2Adapter(error: unknown): Address | null;
```

## Example


```ts
import { UnsupportedVaultV2AdapterError } from "@morpho-org/blue-sdk";
import { getUnsupportedVaultV2Adapter } from "@morpho-org/blue-sdk-viem";

const adapter = getUnsupportedVaultV2Adapter(error);
if (adapter != null) throw new UnsupportedVaultV2AdapterError(adapter);
```
